full_population.selection_rule: Nominal jobs with at least one fp node having >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid T_p95 timestamps. No minimum fp-nodes-per-job requirement.

training_subset_462.selection_rule: Jobs from 1000-job random sample (seed=42) of 3945 nominal jobs, qualifying for power-model slope estimation (>= 8 fp nodes per job, each with >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid timestamps).

excluded_5_jobs.identification_method: Diff of nominal 3945 job IDs (globus_batch.txt pre-2025) vs contributing 3940 job IDs (full_train_t95_distribution.parquet unique job_idx)
excluded_5_jobs.exclusion_criterion: No fp node with >= 8 GCD channels AND >= 5 valid T_p95 timestamps

threshold_consistency.verdict: Full-population p95 = 63.625 C = subset p95 = 63.625 C (delta = 0.0 C). Subset threshold is a reliable estimate.

legacy_T_thr_secondary.provenance: Empirical p95 of node-job GCD temperature observations in the 462-job training subset, computed during phase3b1 analysis. Stored in phase3b1_realism.json empirical_thresholds.T_p95 and used as T_P95_THRESHOLD constant in phase3b2c_calibration.py and downstream scripts. This is the B_secondary / S_secondary threshold. It is NOT the primary threshold used in sc30-54 (which uses p95=63.625 from the full 3940-job population).
